meta.notes: Adds msm_examples:librarian/2/emerald_spyglass to the vanilla trade tag minecraft:librarian/level_2, from which librarians at apprentice level draw their trades. The export merges it into vanilla's tag (replace stays false), so the vanilla trades stay. Each villager draws only a few trades from the tag, so the new one is a candidate, not a certainty: some villagers offer it and others do not. A guaranteed trade needs a trade set of the same name, which replaces vanilla's.
